title: The restricted tower of the actual system direct image
statement: Fix a prime l and a finite extension E of Q_l, schemes X,Y in universe u, a morphism f:X→Y, the actual additive sequence direct image [def-trf-integral-comparison-sequence-systems], K-injective resolutions of its source system category, a normalized coefficient derived system calculus S [lem-coef-derived-system-evaluation-calculus], and an arbitrary K in D(scalarReductionSource l E X). Write N=R f_*(S.reduction(K)) in the derived category of actual coefficient systems and Z=coefficientSequenceDerivedRestriction(N) in the derived category of towers over completed integral coefficients [def-coef-ringed-sequence-site]. For every tower complex T and representing isomorphism e:Q(T)≅Z, the evaluated localized tower T.asFunctor ⋙ Q is isomorphic, as an N-op diagram, to Functor.ofOpSequence(sfDirectImageTransition l E f K). Its nth object is the restricted finite derived image sfDirectImageTerm l E f K n [def-weil-derived-direct-image]. This asserts neither existence nor normalization of any limit, product, projection, boundary or distinguished triangle.

source.place: Construction 4.1, printed p. 21, and Lemma 4.10, printed pp. 23--24; Stacks sites-cohomology.tex Tag 0D6E and more-algebra.tex Tag 06YY.

proof.text: Choose a flat-term K-flat representative P of K. The reductionModel field of the given coefficient calculus identifies a strict system complex C representing S.reduction(Q P), simultaneously at all finite levels. Its transition equation identifies every quotient arrow with ordinary coefficient reduction, not merely its object at each level.

source.place: Construction 4.1, printed p. 21, and Lemma 4.10, printed pp. 23--24; Stacks sites-cohomology.tex Tag 0D6E and more-algebra.tex Tag 06YY.

proof.text: Apply actual sequence-site direct image after a single K-injective resolution of C. Compare completed scalar restriction before and after the image using the diagram ring restriction/direct-image square, keeping its common-composite resolution normalization. The ordinary square is identity on sections and respects every horizontal quotient arrow. Derived composition therefore gives simultaneous finite direct-image comparisons.

source.place: Tag 0D6E, lemma-derived-pushforward-composition, applied to the sequence ringed topoi and exact scalar restrictions.

proof.text: On P the input quotient arrow sends s tensor x to rho(s) tensor x. The representative characterization of sfDerivedReductionTransition identifies it with that map. The normalized derived coefficient restriction comparison is sfDerivedRestrictionComparison. Thus transporting each image arrow gives its inverse at n+1, followed by the completed derived image of the input transition, followed by its comparison at n: exactly sfDirectImageTransition. Assemble these compatible component isomorphisms as an isomorphism of N-op diagrams.

source.place: Construction 4.1, printed p. 21, and Lemma 4.10, printed pp. 23--24; Stacks sites-cohomology.tex Tag 0D6E and more-algebra.tex Tag 06YY.

proof.text: Exact simultaneous evaluation takes quasi-isomorphisms of strict tower complexes to objectwise isomorphisms after localization. Hence it factors through the derived category of strict towers. Its factorization transports the comparison along the representing isomorphism e from any T. There is no choice of an inverse limit or of a triangle in this argument. For zero K or an empty scheme the construction is the same diagram of zero objects; no nonvanishing or boundedness is required.

lean.statement:
theorem systemDirectImage_restrictedTowerComparison
    (l : ℕ) [Fact l.Prime] (E : Type u) [Field E]
    [Algebra ℚ_[l] E] [FiniteDimensional ℚ_[l] E]
    {X Y : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ Y)
    [(integralComparisonSequenceDirectImage l E f).Additive]
    [Abelian.HasKInjectiveResolutions (coefficientSequenceModules l E X)]
    (S : CoefficientDerivedSystemCalculus l E X)
    (K : DerivedCategory (scalarReductionSource l E X))
    (T : CochainComplex (ℕᵒᵖ ⥤ scalarReductionSource l E Y) ℤ)
    (e : DerivedCategory.Q.obj T ≅ (coefficientSequenceDerivedRestriction l E Y).obj
      ((integralComparisonSequenceDirectImage l E f).rightDerivedFunctor.obj
        (S.reduction.obj K))) :
    Nonempty (T.asFunctor ⋙ DerivedCategory.Q ≅
      Functor.ofOpSequence (sfDirectImageTransition l E f K))
